stories.title: Trump Advisers Study Impact of Diesel Export Ban
stories.summary: President Donald Trump's economic advisers are analyzing the ramifications of a potential short-term ban on U.S. diesel exports, underscoring the seriousness of the administration's consideration of the idea.

stories.title: Ukraine Says 2 Russian Refineries Ablaze after Strikes

stories.title: WhiteHawk Completes Acquisition of Appalachia, Haynesville Gas Assets
stories.summary: WhiteHawk completed acquisitions worth a total of $111.8 million including mineral and royalty natural gas assets in the Haynesville shale and the Appalachian Basin's Marcellus and Utica formations.

stories.title: Dutch biodiesel alliance presents action plan to policymakers
stories.summary: The alliance calls for immediate policy measures to further strengthen energy security and strategic autonomy through increased use of biodiesel.

stories.title: American Soybean Association encouraged by extension of US-China trade truce
stories.summary: ASA said it hopes the discussions will build on that progress and deliver additional positive developments for U.S. soybean farmers and agricultural trade.

stories.title: Germany unveils roadmap for transitioning away from fossil fuels
stories.summary: Carsten Schneider, Germany’s minister of the environment, presented the document at the UN General Assembly in New York City.

stories.title: SkyNRG CEO, co-founder to step down
stories.summary: SkyNRG Co-founder Maarten van Dijk will remain CEO until Dec. 31 and will support the company during the handover period through the first quarter of 2027.

stories.title: Henry Hub natural gas prices this summer were 6% lower than last summer

stories.title: Spiritus Secures Preliminary Deals to Supply CO2 for EOR
stories.summary: Spiritus signed three letters of intent with oil and gas operators in the United States Gulf Coast, Midwest and Rockies to supply over three million metric tons of carbon dioxide per year for enhanced oil recovery.

stories.title: TotalEnergies Backs Pouyanne to Remain Chair and CEO
stories.summary: TotalEnergies' board reaffirmed the French energy giant's governance structure and a growth strategy that sticks with oil and gas while expanding integrated power.

stories.title: Storms, Drones And A Walked-Back Export Ban: Why This Week's Selloff Might Not Last

stories.title: INPEX Pre-Empts JERA's Sale of Ichthys LNG Stake to MidOcean
stories.summary: INPEX raises its stake to over 68 percent.

stories.title: Dutch to Ask EU to End Mandatory Gas Storage Targets
stories.summary: The Netherlands wants to scrap mandatory gas storage targets under a revamp of the European Union's energy supply security rules after spending nearly EUR 1 billion this year to fill the country's reserves.

stories.title: After Presley Gerber’s Death, What Families Should Ask About Rehab
stories.summary: Choosing addiction treatment? Learn what to ask about rehab staffing, medication management, costs and continuing care before committing to a program.
